description:
`CodingTuning::CONSERVATIVE` in `crates/gf2-coding/src/tuning.rs` sets the crossovers among the decoder and encoder families without a committed measurement.

## Background

The Rustdoc stated that no committed receipt has measured those crossovers; the source-comment sweep removed the statement, and this issue tracks the measurement.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed receipt from the overnight benchmark window measures each crossover that `CodingTuning` exposes, per `@/inv/benchmark-backed-performance`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each constant's value follows its receipt or is recorded as an unmeasured conservative default in the tuning-profile reference page.
title: Measure the gf2-coding tuning crossovers
